title: ze_untitled_touhou
description:
Beyond the Barrier of Life and Death leads the Netherworld, the resting place of ghosts and phantoms alike. A brilliant flow of spring transcends this boundary and feeds the Saigyou Ayakashi, the largest cherry blossom tree in the garden of Hakugyokurou. Should its seal fail and reveal the most beautiful blossom of all, the charm of its blood-stained pedals shall once again bewitch the souls of many to their demise. Traverse the lands of life beyond and preserve its seal before you behold the Perfect Cherry Blossom. 

 
This is a port of my Touhou-inspired map from the 2024 NiDE Mapping Contest.
It is based on 東方妖々夢 ～ Perfect Cherry Blossom — 

There are various gameplay changes from CS:S including a majority of the defenses being modified and a rework of the staircase area.

 This map features: 
 
 A simplistic reimagining of the Netherworld and Hakugyokurou.

 Bullet-hell style boss fights with a unique I-Frame system.

 Music.
 

 Requires CS2Fixes for health and speed KeyValues. 

Thanks to Vanya.

Be sure to report any issues. Enjoy.
